status: DRAFT_FOR_DEV_ONLY (never activates a forward window, never opens validation, locked, paper or IW1 data)
data_state_when_written: no index-price kline downloaded or used in this session; perp daily klines and funding for these symbols are downloaded for H_LIST at this time but not yet used for this hypothesis
hypothesis: A market-neutral long-spot / short-perp book (funding harvest) on 16 liquid USDT perpetuals earns, after one-time entry/exit cost, a return that is (a) at least 3x its round-trip cost per year at cost 0 and (b) above a cash-like hurdle. ADR 0020 CC1 measured funding only and set the basis P&L to 0 (its stated limit); this closes that gap using Binance index price (composite spot index) as the spot leg.
what_the_author_had_already_seen: ADR 0020: CC1 funding income 6.5%/yr gross, 4.0% net S1, 2.6% S2 for 15 alts (basis assumed 0); later S1 pieces had negative funding. This is disclosed. Basis noise was not seen.

configs.rule: always long index / short perp, equal weight per symbol that has data, daily open-to-open P&L, one entry and one exit per symbol per segment
hold a symbol only while its trailing 7-day mean funding (known at the day open) is > 0; entering or leaving pays cost each time

pnl: per day per symbol: ret_index_open_to_open - ret_perp_open_to_open + funding settled that day (short receives positive). Leg notional 1 each; capital = 2 (spot cash + perp margin at 1x), reported per capital.
cost: perp side: ADR 0041 volume-scaled measured cost at the entry/exit bar; spot side: 15bp per side assumed (taker 10bp + 5bp, same as ADR 0020), rows measured, spot_x2, cost0. Index vs real spot difference is NOT measured (limitation).
hurdle: cash-like 4.0%/yr on capital (assumed stablecoin lending rate, disclosed assumption; not a measurement)
criteria_DEV_PROMISING_all_required_per_: a) cost-0 annual return per capital >= 3 x annualized round-trip cost (B1: one round trip per segment; B2: all its entries/exits), in S1 and S2 separately
b) net annual return per capital > hurdle 4.0% in S1 and S2
c) net annualized Sharpe >= 1.0 in S1 and S2
d) net return positive in both halves of S1
e) worst 30-day drawdown reported; max drawdown <= 10% of capital in both segments
f) net return positive at spot_x2 cost
verdict_rule: DEV_PROMISING only means a note may say the premium is real after cost; it is a risk premium, not alpha, and activates nothing.
